verses.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me, because the LORD anointed me to bring good news to the humble. He sent me to bandage broken hearts, to announce freedom for captives and release for people tied up,
to announce the year of the LORD's favor and our God's day of vengeance, to comfort everyone who mourns,

to care for those grieving in Zion, giving them a crown in place of ashes, oil of joy in place of mourning, and clothes of praise in place of a heavy spirit. They'll be called trees of righteousness, planted by the LORD so he'll be glorified.
They'll rebuild the old ruins and raise up places that were wrecked long ago. They'll repair cities that have been desolate for generations.
Strangers will stand out there feeding your flocks. Foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.
But you'll be called the LORD's priests. People will call you servants of our God. You'll live on the wealth of the nations and take pride in their glory.
In place of shame you'll have a double share. In place of disgrace you'll celebrate what you receive. You'll own double in your land, and the joy you have will never end.
“I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and wrongdoing. I'll give them what they've earned faithfully, and I'll make a covenant with them that lasts forever.
Their children will be known among the nations, and their descendants among the peoples. Everyone who sees them will recognize them as the family the LORD has blessed.”

I'm going to celebrate the LORD with everything I've got! My soul will find joy in my God. He's dressed me in clothes of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, like a groom putting on his crown or a bride getting dressed in her jewels.
Just like the earth pushes up new shoots and a garden makes the seeds in it sprout, the Lord GOD will make righteousness and praise spring up right in front of all the nations.
